question:
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence.

The volunteers will _______ the neighbourhood to gather support for the new policy.
solution:
The correct answer is '**canvass**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**canvass**" means to solicit votes, opinions, or support. (मत या समर्थन मांगना)
 
• In the given sentence, the volunteers are gathering support for a policy, so "canvass" is the appropriate word.
 
• The other options: "**canvas**," "**canopies**," and "**cannabis**" do not fit the context.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The volunteers will canvass__ the neighbourhood to gather support for the new policy.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Canvas (कैनवास)**: refers to a strong fabric used for painting or making sails.
 
• **Canopies (छतरी)**: refers to an overhead covering, such as a roof or tent.
 
• **Cannabis (भांग)**: refers to a plant used for medicinal or recreational purposes.
